title: CRM v1 (ADR-0047)
description: The optional CRM domain's wire: the record a read answers, the references snapshot a workspace commit carries, binding and change results, and the typed refusals.

audience.description: Present only on an answer to a room with people from outside the org: the fields are the public ones, the narrative is null, and the org's own facts (sources, links it cannot show, proposals, bindings, pages, identifiers) are empty.

can_review.description: False for an agent: a person accepts or rejects with their own credential.

mentioned_in.description: ADR-0047 d5: pages that link this record, only from workspaces the caller is a member of (an administrator sees all). Others are omitted with no count.

bound_to.description: ADR-0047 d6: workspaces bound to this record whose members get derived grants — every binding for an administrator, the caller's own otherwise.

match_ids.description: Match identifiers (email:, domain:, calendar:) — shown to a caller who reads every field.

account_id.description: ADR-0047 d3: the account attached to this person entity; null for an external person.

ReferencesSnapshot.description: The refs of a `workspace.references.changed` fact and the body of POST /internal/references: one workspace's whole set of record references (and its roster) at one commit. A full snapshot, so applying it twice changes nothing and an older commit never overwrites a newer one.

committed_at.description: ISO-8601 commit time; the ordering key

members.description: policy/members.json at that commit; absent when the workspace has none

Refusal.description: A typed refusal, the same body every service answers (gateway-identity.v1). The desk adds propose_instead, desk_changed, proposals_pending_max, proposals_daily_max, not_readable, ref_kind_not_enabled and desk_placements_max. Cards (desktop D2) answer the same reasons: propose_instead (an agent makes or changes no card; it proposes), person_confirmation_required (members are a person's), proposals_pending_max, proposals_daily_max, not_readable. Workspace settings answer person_only: only the person, or their agent in a turn they typed in their own one-person chat, changes them.

version.description: desk_changed only: the desktop's current version, to read and retry on.

DeskSection.description: One section of the desktop, in display order.

DeskLayout.description: One person's desktop arrangement with defaults filled in. The sections array order IS the section order; a section type that appears later is appended at the end.

order.description: Per section, the refs in the order the person arranged; unlisted items follow.

hidden_cards.description: Desktop D2: member cards this person took off their desktop (their own view; the card and its membership are untouched). Placing one again shows it.

DeskOp.description: One declarative desktop operation. A list of 1..50 is applied in order; a bad one refuses the whole list naming its index.

DeskProposal.description: A pending desktop suggestion (7 days to live), shown beside Apply / Not now.

Desk.description: What desktop_read / POST /desk/read answers: the person's own desktop. Version 0 is the default.

cards.description: Desktop D2 (desktop_cards on): the cards on this desktop — the ones the person is a member of (minus those they took off) and the ones they placed, in their order.

card_invites.description: Cards this person was added to and has not accepted yet; never on the desktop by themselves.

ArrangeResult.description: What desktop_arrange, an applied suggestion and Undo answer: the new version, the one Undo restores, and one plain line of what changed.

CardFaceBlock.description: One resolved block of a card face (blocks.v1's face profile, resolved for one viewer by card_face.py). Structural blocks draw from the CardView; data blocks arrive filled; a field the viewer may not read is `locked`.

CardMovement.description: One movement of a card, from its revisions: who (the proposer when a person accepted an agent's proposal), and what in words.

CardView.description: Desktop D2: one card as one viewer may read it — a CRM record of a card type (`x-card`). Fields the viewer cannot read are null; the face is resolved for them; children count only what they read; `workspaces` are the boards referencing it that they are a member of. `activity` only on a single read (POST /card/read).

about.description: What the card is about. Membership never grants it: the viewer opens it under their own access.

can.description: What this viewer may do with their own credential. Always false for an agent: it proposes.

new.description: This viewer has never opened the card and did not make it; clears when their terminal renders it in view (POST /card/seen, the session credential, D14).

kind.description: D11: what obligation the card is; picks its seeded lifecycle template (card_templates.py). Null for a plain board card.

next_actor.description: D11: the person id whose move it is. Every open card of a kind has exactly one.

requester.description: D11: the person waiting on it (confirms a delivery, uses an answer). Defaults to the card owner.

next_check_at.description: D11: when the flows worker next checks the open card.

seen.description: Whether the next actor has seen it since the offer: present only to the next actor, and to the requester when policy card_seen_visible_to_sender is on (N-7).

handoff.description: D12: custody of the current gate — offered to the next actor until acknowledged.

gates.description: The route as a strip of gates (converged §13).

decisions.description: D13: the decision records, newest first.

viewer.description: This viewer's position: their role, whether they have seen it since the offer, and the gate actions they may take now (only the next actor has any).

CardProposal.description: Desktop D2: a pending card proposal this person may answer (crm_review): a new card (`create`, into a workspace's board or the proposing person's own) or a change to a card they are a member of (`change`; a stage move is `fields.State`). Expires after card_proposal_ttl_days.

CardList.description: What card_list / POST /card/list answers: the cards this caller reads (a workspace's board, their own, or both) and the pending proposals they may answer.

CardResult.description: What a person's POST /card/create and /card/update answer.

WorkspaceSettings.description: One person's settings for one workspace, on the CRM member_of relation (crm_member_settings): private to the person, written only by crm-api. A slug with no row reads as the defaults (false, false, false, [], null, [], null). They carry no access.

notify.description: DEPRECATED (PRD 0.13.4 S6): never written or answered. A room's or workspace's notification level lives in the person's identity notification policy (GET/PUT /user/notifications, `rooms`: ws:<slug>).

room_order.description: Chat ids in the person's order.

level.description: The person's level override for this workspace; null follows their default.

updated_at.description: When the person last changed them; null only for the defaults.

WorkspaceSettingsMap.description: What workspace_settings_read / POST /desk/workspaces/read answers: the caller's own rows only, keyed by workspace slug. A slug never set is absent (read it as the defaults).

WorkspaceSettingsResult.description: What workspace_settings_set / POST /desk/workspaces/set answers: the slug and the full settings after the change.

CardDecision.description: D13: one decision record — an append-only card revision a person wrote with the session credential, bound to a server nonce and the content hash of the face they saw.

CardInbox.description: POST /card/inbox: the open cards waiting on this person (they are the next actor) and the counts the Now strip, the Inbox and a room badge read — one predicate.

CardNonce.description: POST /card/nonce: a server nonce bound to this person, this card at this revision and the content hash of the face shown now (D13).
